title: Marryandbride category words
description: Three or so garment categories as big light serif words, stacked and centred. From 1024px the section is as tall as the window and split in half: the words centred on white at the left, a photo filling the right half; pointing at (or focusing) a word crossfades the photo to that category's own in 0.4s. On phones only the words show.
notes: each category carries its own photo slot; empty ones show bg-muted placeholders in slightly different tints so the swap is visible
the photo swap needs JavaScript; static HTML shows the first category's photo
